text.p: Italian BTP futures edged lower in early trading following the trend of other European markets on a mixture of profit-taking and worries over the high level of the dollar which touched 1.84 dollar/mark in overnight trade.
Dealers said that the BTP market had gained strongly recently and the profit-taking of Thursday and early today was a sign of some consolidation after such a sharp rise.
"The market is a little nervous with the dollar so high, so we were bound to see a little bit of early caution today," said one dealer on the LIFFE market.
The lira was largely steady in the 973-974/mark area despite the higher dollar.
There was little domestic news to influence the market and dealers say BTPs would look to overseas market for direction.
